the air quality emergency in the Indian capital city Delhi in the winter 2015–2016 was a result of a large natural dust event in the Middle East that was linked to local smoke from agricultural fires in India.
the winter 2018 air quality crisis in Delhi was due to the mixing of local pollution with smoke and dust transported from the Middle East and northwest India.
the winter 2016-17 air quality emergency in the Indian Capital, Delhi, was caused by the mixing of smoke from agricultural fires with dust emitted from a natural dust storm in the Middle East.
